name: @lp-labs/react-state-machine
description: Typed state-machine modeling, deterministic interpretation, and controlled React editor.

scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types-esm.json && tsc -p tsconfig.types-cjs.json && node -e "const f=require('node:fs'); for(const p of ['dist/esm','dist/types/esm']) { f.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true}); f.writeFileSync(p+'/package.json',JSON.stringify({type:'module'})); } for(const p of ['dist/cjs','dist/types/cjs']) { f.mkdirSync(p,{recursive:true}); f.writeFileSync(p+'/package.json',JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'})); } f.cpSync('src/style.css','dist/style.css')" && tsc -p tsconfig.consumer.json
